transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: A record counts only when event.name is api_request or body is claude_code.api_request, session.id is present, and at least one token bucket or cost_usd parses.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: totalTokens sums the present buckets, treating a missing bucket as 0, and is omitted when the only metric is cost. meterTokens is input plus output with the same zero fill, and only when some token bucket exists.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: freshInputTokens is a copy of inputTokens, not a separate measurement. pricing.contextTokens is set only when input, cache read, and cache creation are all present.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: The driver drops a repeated fingerprint and drops records whose session.id is not the native session. It emits usage:tokens-used when otelUsageEnabled is true, including when the version is unverified.

transforms.name: adapter-step-4
transforms.effect: Capabilities mark usage degraded unless OTLP is both enabled and version-verified. Events can therefore flow while the declaration says degraded.

transforms.name: adapter-step-5
transforms.effect: Transcript batch listeners are never called. Historical transcript usage is not imported.
